groups.defect: The align-items mixin emits the invalid -ms-align-items property and lacks -moz-box-align for legacy Firefox.
groups.rationale: Both report the same invalid declaration in the same mixin. s_1480fde3 additionally reports the missing Firefox declaration, which the unified comment must preserve.

groups.defect: The order mixin passes the modern order value directly to legacy box-ordinal-group properties without the required +1 adjustment.
groups.rationale: All five report the same indexing mismatch in the same mixin. Differences in browser examples and consumer references do not identify separate defects.
